title: Rav Kahana bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 8b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.8b.7): “Rav Kahana bar Tachlifa said in the name of Rav Kahana bar Minyomi, in the name of Rav Kahana, Rav’s teacher — and some say Rav Kahana mar Malkiyu [supplied מר; the named Talmud witness has בר], that is Rav Kahana, Rav’s teacher … Rav Kahana said: Since this is a teaching of Kahanas, I will say something about it.” The Bach reads (instead of “in the name of Rav Kahana, Rav’s teacher”) “in the name of Rav Kahana Rabbah, and some say Rav Kahana bar Malkiyu, that is Rav Kahana Rabbah.” Dikdukei Soferim reads “Rav Huna bar Tachlifa in the name of Rav Kahana Rabbah.” In the Pesaro, Venice רפה, Giustiniani, Basel and Constantinople printings, it reads (instead of bar Minyomi) bar Mattityah, and so it is in the [Or Zarua, vol. II, §114](https://www.sefaria.org/Ohr_Zarua%2C_Volume_II.114.1), and in Yuchasin.

He is likewise mentioned in [Menachot 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.66b.11) (Hyman gives סי:): “Rav Kahana bar Tachlifa raised an objection to Rav Kahana bar Mattityah.” In [Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Avodah_Zarah.2.9.3): “Rabbi Zeira, Kahana bar Tachlifa, Chanan bar Ba in the name of Rav.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2297&lang=en) give the main chain as Tachlifa → Minyomi → bar Malkiyu → Rav’s teacher. The alternate wording identifies bar Malkiyu with Rav’s teacher. The Or Zarua has Mattityah in place of Minyomi and keeps bar Malkiyu in the chain. The linked Menachot has bar Mattityah in parentheses. The linked Yerushalmi gives Zeira, Kahana bar Tachlifa, and Chanan bar Ba in a transmission in Rav’s name. Hyman quotes the other apparatus and edition readings.
